releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.170: Diary Lock not-set message appears inside the app without a browser alert or website address; matching signed APK and Check for Update feed. Existing documents, saved images, notes, PIN, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Diary Lock: when '🔓 Diary Lock Band Karein' is tapped while no PIN lock is set, 'Diary Lock is not set.' appears inside the app without a browser alert or website address. The APK release embeds the same update.
